source_basis.primary: Talbot and Ogden 2008, WRR 44 W08453, DOI 10.1029/2008WR006815, section 2.3 paragraphs 24-26
source_semantics: precipitation depth available to infiltrate equals surface flux times dt
bins are treated sequentially from the lowest-water-content left-most bin
for an unsaturated-at-surface dry bin a precomputed dry-bin front depth Z_d is set
the corresponding water volume is subtracted from the volume available for infiltration
the process continues through successive bins until water is exhausted or the last bin is reached
water remaining after satisfying the right-most bin belongs to surface ponding/runoff handling

qualified_scope.event: creation of one or more fully funded dry-bin wetting fronts
qualified_scope.dry_front_depth_Zd: immutable supplied fixture; its Green-Ampt computation is not qualified here
qualified_scope.insufficient_water_policy: fail closed before commit and route to an explicitly unqualified fallback path
qualified_scope.front_slot_precondition: one free bounded slot must be available for every newly created front

hard_guards: Do not infer a partial dry-bin front when available water is smaller than the full Z_d storage demand.
Do not qualify the Green-Ampt successive-approximation calculation of Z_d in this gate.
Do not silently consume rainfall on rejected trials; forcing remains external until commit/fallback.
Do not add per-column persistent copies of immutable Z_d fixture data.
Mass conservation is absolute and no clip, merge, or repair is allowed.
No redistribution, groundwater, crop, runtime, or MultiSWAP production qualification.
